Check the [design specification](https://github.com/kserksi/pebril-web/wiki/24-Design-System-Spec) and the relevant wiki page first; many behaviours are deliberate. Keep unconfirmed requirements as proposals rather than assumptions.

## Problem

What is missing or awkward today, and for whom?

## Proposal

Describe the change. Note whether it touches colour, type, spacing, components or motion, and which spec section would need to change.

## Scope and cost

Pages affected, new assets or requests, and whether it changes the "zero third-party requests" rule.

## Alternatives

What you considered instead, and why the proposal is preferable.
